verdict.rationale: PayPal documents the full agent checkout chain. The ACP path for ChatGPT has merchants manage checkout sessions and receive a delegated, one-time-use Braintree token via a `complete_checkout` tool. The UCP path for Google AI Mode passes a single-use token in `credential.token` to the merchant's `/checkout-session/{id}/complete` endpoint. Store Sync lets agents complete purchases, with orders flowing into the merchant's existing order system. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of a completed end-to-end agent purchase, explicit documentation of the order-confirmation response returned to the agent on the ACP/UCP paths, and broader availability (access is form-gated and Braintree- or Google-gated, and Store Sync covers only US physical goods in USD).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can complete a purchase end-to-end — checkout session, delegated payment credential, confirmed order
